title: Determinantal linear spanning forests
summary: We introduce a determinantal linear process on the space of $1$-forms over a weighted graph endowed with a unitary local system, which we call the determinantal linear spanning forest (DLSF). This process is the analog of the uniform spanning tree in the presence of an arbitrary rank $n$ quenched gauge field in ${\rm U}(n)$ (or ${\rm O}(n)$, ${\rm SO}(n)$, ${\rm SU}(n)$, ${\rm Sp}(n)$), and generalizes the determinantal random cycle-rooted spanning forest which corresponds to the case of ${\rm U}(1)$ and ${\rm SU}(2)$.
